description_en: Queries statistical reports, such as application, drop-down suggestion, top search hint, A/B test, and data quality reports
description_zh: 应用场景有：应用报表、下拉提示报表、热词底纹报表、abtest报表、数据质量报告等
kebab_example: aliyun opensearch list-statistic-report --app-group-identity app_group_name --module-name suggest --start-time 1582214400 --end-time 1582646399 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --columns pv,uv --query bizType:test,sceneTag:myTag --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListStatisticReport

parameters.help_en:
The name of the module. This is an enumeration. Valid values:

- app: Operations report.

- app-query: Operations report > Query analysis metrics.

- abtest: A/B test report.

- suggest: Drop-down suggestion report.

- hot: Top search report.

- hint: Hint report.

- data-quality: Behavioral data. Paging parameters are not supported.

- es: Report for an open source-compatible instance
parameters.help_zh:
模块名称，为枚举值

- app   （业务运营报表）
- app-query （业务运营报表>Query分析指标）
- abtest （A/B测试报表）
- suggest （下拉提示报表）
- hot （热搜报表）
- hint （底纹报表）
- data-quality (行为数据，不支持分页参数)
- es （开源兼容版实例报表）
parameters.name: module_name

parameters.help_en: The end timestamp, in seconds. The default value is the current timestamp
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间默认为当前时间戳（单位：秒）
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回数目，默认 pageSize = 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The fields to query. Specify the fields in the columns="pv,uv,ipv" format. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187665.html
parameters.help_zh:
查询的字段
格式为 colums=”pv,uv,ipv”,参考：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187665.html
parameters.name: columns

parameters.help_en:
The query conditions, in the k1:v1,k2:v2 format. Valid values:

- experimentSerialNumber: the globally unique serial number of the experiment.

- sceneTag: the tag of the scenario.

- bizType: the business identity.

- modelId: the ID of the algorithm model
parameters.help_zh:
查询条件，格式 k1:v1,k2:v2

- experimentSerialNumber 实验的全局唯一序列号
- sceneTag 场景标识
- bizType 业务标识
- modelId 算法模型ID
parameters.name: query
